helpful: The provisioned application text was complete through the argument and signature despite the truncated flag; it carried everything the forecast needed.
The statpack interim section's per-Term rows made the strictly-prior pool arithmetic straightforward.
gaps: fedcourts query cannot filter applications to the substantive kind, so a --disposition granted query over applications is swamped by time-extension grants and surfaces no comparable stay grants.

No cut of the interim grant rate by applicant class (federal government / state / private) or by originating-court type (state court vs federal), which is the single biggest adjustment an interim cell makes and currently has to be done from judgment.
CourtListener has no record of fresh SCOTUS application dockets, so forward-mode retrieval about the case itself returned nothing.
notes: The query CLI's usage error on a free-text argument is clear and self-correcting; one wasted call.
